source_title: India U20 women stun New Zealand 17-0 in major rugby sevens upset - Sportstar
source_excerpt: CHENNAI India’s under-20 women’s rugby sevens team defeated New Zealand’s (Maori) U20 invitational side 17-0 in the India-New Zealand Rugby Series at the Rajgir Sports Complex in Bihar on Tuesday. The Indian women made a strong start, taking a 12-0 lead at half-time before adding another try after the break to complete a convincing victory. Meanwhile, the Indian men’s U20 team suffered a 32-0 defeat against the visiting New Zealand Maori side. The bilateral series was organised to commemorate 100 years of sporting ties between India and New Zealand. It also featured two mixed-team exhibition matches, with players from both countries competing alongside one another.
